project.name: ChangeFrame
project.summary: A WebMCP decision room where humans set constraints and approve outcomes while agents evaluate options, simulate impact, and draft the change.
project.ai_usage: A browser agent discovers phase-specific WebMCP tools, reads shared decision state, evaluates and revises options, simulates project impact, prepares the decision, and drafts the change order only after human approval.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported product scoping, PRD development, implementation, debugging, deterministic and browser-level testing, production hardening, documentation, and submission preparation.
